verdict.rationale: Helicone is fundamentally an API/SDK-based proxy and observability layer (one-line SDK integration, REST API, OpenAPI/swagger spec, self-hosted Docker Compose), which is inherently well-suited to headless/CI use, and webhooks/alerts support automation workflows. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, CLI tool, or automated testing pipeline evidence—usage is inferred from its API-first architecture rather than directly demonstrated for CI contexts.
